title: BayaHAR: Lightweight Bayesian Few-Shot User Adaptation for On-Device Personalized Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2606.04798v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) models often degrade on unseen users due to domain shifts caused by individual movement patterns and sensor placement. Practical wearable HAR systems therefore require personalization methods that are lightweight, applicable across diverse calibration scenarios, and robust under limited calibration data. We present BayaHAR, a gradient-free framework that repurposes pretrained HAR classifiers as Prototypical Networks using prior prototypes that preserve zero-shot performance while regularizing adaptation. For labeled calibration data, we introduce closed-form Bayesian prototype estimation and extend the same principle to weakly labeled data, requiring only knowledge of which activities were performed. translated_title: BayaHAR：面向设备端个性化人体活动识别的轻量级贝叶斯少样本用户自适应方法
translated_abstract: 基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）模型在应用于未见过的用户时，由于个体运动模式和传感器佩戴位置差异造成的域偏移，性能往往会下降。因此，实用的可穿戴HAR系统需要既轻量级、又能适用于多种校准场景、并在校准数据有限时保持鲁棒性的个性化方法。我们提出了BayaHAR，这是一个无需梯度计算的框架，它将预训练的HAR分类器改造为基于先验原型的原型网络，先验原型在保持零样本性能的同时对自适应过程进行正则化。对于有标签的校准数据，我们引入了闭式解的贝叶斯原型估计方法，并将相同原理扩展到弱标签数据，此时只需知道用户执行了哪些活动即可。每项活动仅需3秒的校准数据（单样本），有监督自适应方法在四个数据集上将未见用户的测试宏F1提升了2.76至33.44个百分点，而弱标签……
tldr: 提出BayaHAR框架，利用闭式贝叶斯原型估计实现免梯度、轻量级的少样本用户自适应，仅需每项活动3秒校准数据即可将个性化人体活动识别在未见用户上的宏F1提升最高33.44个百分点。
en_tdlr: BayaHAR is a gradient-free, lightweight Bayesian prototypical framework for few-shot user adaptation in on-device personalized HAR, boosting unseen-user macro-F1 by up to 33.44 percentage points with only 3 seconds of calibration per activity.
